mechanism_narrative: A sustained acceleration in GDP growth (GDPC1) over the preceding 5 quarters, combined with a concurrent rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST), signals an expansionary demand shock that drives corporate earnings growth and equity valuations upward, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the composite demand signal fails to correlate with earnings revisions (Pearson r < 0.2) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit margins and consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the unemployment signal fails to correlate with earnings revisions (Pearson r < -0.2) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real retail sales (RSAFS) below $350 billion signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the retail sales signal fails to correlate with earnings revisions (Pearson r > 0.2) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 index points signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the industrial production signal fails to correlate with earnings revisions (Pearson r > 0.2) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units signals an acceleration in residential construction that boosts corporate earnings in the homebuilding sector and related industries, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the housing starts signal fails to correlate with earnings revisions (Pearson r < 0.2) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and reduces corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the unemployment signal fails to correlate with earnings revisions (Pearson r < -0.2) over a 3-year rolling window.
